comparison.objective: Open a loaded locker and transfer a leaning case upright; candidate performs sensor calibration.
comparison.physical_skill: Support-aware door opening and orientation-preserving transfer versus confined screwdriver and mounted-component adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Case never tipped or dropped and finishes released upright on a mat for 1 s; candidate requires two retained sensor registrations.
comparison.reason: No shared tested ability beyond general manipulation. Candidate still needs exact component geometry and tightening limits.
